fields.summary_ko.0: ULA Vulcan rocket launch failure resulted in loss of 40 Amazon satellites, with space-related stocks declining: ASTS (-4%), RKLB (-3%), LUNR (-2%), FLY (-1%).
fields.summary_ko.1: Analyst Tim Farrar urged SpaceX CEO Musk to guarantee 50+ annual Falcon 9 flights; he suggests 100+ flights are possible in 2027 when Starlink transitions to Starship.
